name: Omarchy Lacquer
author: deunnis
description: One app for how your Omarchy desktop looks: themes, wallpapers, theme shuffle and aether generation; fonts, GTK, icons, cursor and nightlight; windows, animations and curves; shell style, bar and menu look; lock, boot and screensaver; terminals, btop and prompt; and every plugin's settings. Live, through the tools that already own each setting.
